Class Theme

java.lang.Object
com.taskflow.ui.Theme
public final class Theme extends Object
Central place for colours and fonts, with a light and a dark mode.

Both palettes are built from the five colours chosen for the project: white #ffffff, light grey #e5e7eb, navy #1f2937, grey #9ca3af and blue #346ec9. Components never store colours; they ask p() every time they paint, so switching the mode only needs a repaint.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Ibrahim Masood
